title: docs/guide-anchors.md: for Linus and the other anchors
description: Flag day: register and merge first with anchors.json, approve the first maintainers, switch gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile to the --min-tier maintainer export, release tooling to --min-tier anchor, sign the first SSH release tag.
